title: Shyam Singha Roy
desc: A director accused of plagiarism finds a transcendental connection to his past life when he digs deeper into his subconscious mind.

title: Yengalai Pol Yaarum Illai
desc: A doctor living abroad returns to India to sell his property, where he falls in love.

title: Yamakaathaghi
desc: After the demise of a young woman, her spirit remains inside her funeral home and refuses to leave. Soon, her death leads to a disturbing supernatural investigation.

title: Aavesham
desc: Three boys move into a hostel to pursue engineering, where they clash with seniors. To get revenge, they befriend a gangster.

title: Bullet Raja
desc: Bullet Raja is killed by Babu, a goon, because both love the same girl. Bullet fights with the god of death and is sent back into the body of Ravindra, a minister who was killed by his own associates.

title: Aruvam
desc: A woman with anosmia experiences paranormal events and soon finds herself involved in a series of mysterious murders linked to food adulteration.

title: Circle
desc: Fifty strangers, held captive and facing execution, must make an impossible decision of choosing one among them who deserves to live while the others perish.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Penguin
desc: Rhythm, a pregnant woman, is traumatised by nightmares about the unsolved kidnapping of her first child, Ajay. Later, she embarks on a harrowing mission to solve the mystery of his disappearance.

title: Thambi
desc: Parvathy is hesitant to accept her brother, Saravanan, who returns home after 15 years. Soon, she discovers that not everything is as it seems and uncovers a well-planned conspiracy.

title: Kalvan
desc: Kemban abandons his adopted grandfather in a forest to die at the hands of an animal, so that he would be compensated by the forest department. But the old man keeps surviving, which annoys Kemban.

title: Thudikkum Karangal
desc: Balu works as a clerk in Ramesh's estate and is very loyal to him. However, when Ramesh accidentally kills Balu, the victim's brother Gopi becomes furious and decides to avenge his death.

title: Adanga Maru
desc: Subhash, a daredevil officer, raises his voice against injustice when he comes across a few politically influential people. However, when his family is brutally murdered, he sets out to exact revenge.

title: Sokkali Mainor
desc: A widow decides to seek the help of her husband's spirit when she sees the marital life of her son shattering in front of her.

title: Kodiyil Oruvan
desc: An ordinary IAS aspirant, who helps out many misguided youths in his locality and shares a close bond with his mother, takes on a huge challenge when he opposes a powerful miscreant.

title: Ragasiya Kolaiyaali
desc: A crime expert races against time to help Kerala police catch a serial killer responsible for multiple murders before more victims fall prey.
